items: Start any heading on a new page
Open the text style menu on a heading, or its block menu, and pick Starts a new page. Ctrl+Enter adds a page break right where you are typing.
Smoother controls
Align, wrap, source type and every switch now slide into place, and Essay Builder opens full screen.
Templates for every subject

New starters with their own Check lists: Business Management IA, Digital Society IA, English Individual Oral, French and Arabic writing tasks, and CAS reflections and projects. Arabic and French words now count properly.
Error bars and best-fit lines
Science graphs can show error bars from a column, a fixed value or a percentage, plus a line of best fit with its equation and R².
Back up your essays for free
Keep your essays in OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox with one click from the home screen. Nothing is lost if your computer breaks.
Updates install themselves
When a new version is ready, press Update and Essay Builder restarts on the new version by itself.
Page numbers in citations
Click any citation to add a page, like (Smith, 2020, p. 45), or write it as Smith (2020, p. 45) in your sentence.
Pages you can trust
Write view now matches your PDF exactly, footnotes show at the bottom of the page, and pages keep updating even while something needs fixing.
A cleaner, smoother app
One Design menu, one Add button, menus that work with the keyboard, and smooth motion everywhere.
Never lose work
If your essay is changed on another computer, Essay Builder keeps both versions instead of overwriting.
Report a problem
Help has a Report a problem button. You can see exactly what is sent, and your essay text is never included.
